Are you...

- Interested in building automation that ensures the reliability and quality of foundational cloud services? 
- Passionate about software engineering, API testing, distributed systems, and building quality into CI/CD? 
- Excited about solving complex testing challenges across a growing SaaS platform? 

If so, we'd love to meet you.

Why Esko? 

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.

About The Role

As an SDET on the Cloud Platform team, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of the foundational services that power Esko's cloud products.

You will work closely with software engineers, architects, and DevOps engineers to build automated testing for platform capabilities such as data and repository services, workflow, search, identity and access management services.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys writing code, understanding how distributed systems behave, finding difficult failure scenarios, and building automation that helps engineering teams release with confidence.

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and maintain automated tests and test frameworks for cloud platform services and APIs. 
- Build API, integration, contract, regression, system, and end-to-end tests for distributed services. 
- Test complex platform behaviors including data integrity, asynchronous workflows, service interactions, authentication and authorization, and failure scenarios. 
- Build performance, scalability, and reliability tests for critical platform services. 
- Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast feedback to engineering teams. 
- Develop test infrastructure, test data, mocks, and tooling needed to test complex cloud services. 
- Investigate failures across distributed systems using logs, metrics, traces, and other diagnostic information. 
- Partner with software engineers and architects to improve testability and build quality into the software development lifecycle. 
- Contribute to automation standards, testing practices, and continuous improvement across the Cloud Platform team. 

Required Experience

- 5+ years of experience in SDET, Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, or Test Automation roles. 
- Strong programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another modern programming language. 
- Hands-on experience building automated tests for REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications. 
- Experience with API, integration, regression, and system-level testing. 
- Good understanding of distributed systems and common testing challenges such as asynchronous processing, retries, failures, and service dependencies. 
- Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent. 
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
- Ability to work effectively with software engineers, architects, product managers, and DevOps engineers. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform. 
- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized applications. 
- Experience with performance and load testing using JMeter, Gatling or equivalent. 
- Experience with API contract testing and testing event-driven or asynchronous systems. 
- Experience debugging distributed systems using observability tools, logs, metrics, and traces. 
- Experience with Playwright, Selenium, or other UI automation frameworks. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will:

- Establish performance testing and baseline metrics for critical platform services to identify performance regressions early. 
- Increase automated coverage of API, integration, reliability, and performance scenarios. 
- Identify defects and failure scenarios earlier in the development lifecycle. 
- Improve CI/CD quality gates and reduce dependence on manual regression testing. 
- Become a trusted engineering partner who helps teams design more testable, reliable, and scalable platform services.

Key responsibilities

Testing SAM publisher implementations

- Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not. 
- Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts.

Building and running test automation

- Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight. 
- Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks. 
- Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers. 

Quality process and reporting

- Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current. 
- Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT. 
- Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment.

Qualifications

- Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience. 
- Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance.
